_note: Single-source (Plains horse-nomads: Comanche, Apache, Cheyenne). Plains sub-palette of the North American family, Comanche-leaning (Numina ~ Numunuu). Buffalo-hunting bands and warrior-societies of grass and scrub, moving with the herds. clan = clanhold. Seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic. Common-word lexicon and rank titles use the real Plains register (allowed, catalog 5.3); DEITY names are morphs of the Agrippan canon (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.plains), never real Plains gods.

phonology.palette: Plains, Comanche-leaning: roots paa (water), toya (mountain), huupi (tree), soni (grass), taabe (sun), mua (moon), puuku (horse), numu (people); the barred-u vowel (written u); endings -pu/-bo/-tu; Apache nantan; pan-Plains akicita. Descriptive deed-names in the usual rendering.

morphology.patronymic_form: the band/division name (Comanche, e.g. Kwahada, Penateka); a child-name replaced at coming-of-age by an earned deed- or vision-name; descriptive epithets.
morphology.compounding_rule: [quality|animal](stem) + feature: Eka-toya (red-mountain), Kutsu-sonipi (bison-grassland); the band named for its food or range; deed-names rendered descriptively (Ten Bears, Iron Shirt).

title_ladder.government: clanhold (a confederation of bands led by peace-chiefs and war chiefs; the warrior-societies and the chiefs' council raise the head-chief; the camp moves with the herds)
title_ladder._tiers_note: Plains clanhold, ascending. Nantan (Apache, band headman) barony; Tekwuniwap (Comanche war chief) march; Paraibo (Comanche band peace-chief) county; Akicita-paraibo (warrior-society headman) duchy; Pia-Paraibo (great chief over several bands) principality; Tabe-Naika (head-chief of the confederation's council) kingdom; Pia-Tabe-Naika (grand head-chief) empire. The chiefs' council and the warrior-societies check the chiefs; a nomad confederation rarely holds past the head-chief. (Rank titles draw on the real Plains register, allowed.)

people_name_convention.order: a child-name, replaced at coming-of-age by an earned deed- or vision-name; the band/division; descriptive epithets (animal + quality), rendered in the usual way.
people_name_convention.dual_register: chiefs and braves bear deed-names and society-honors; others a band-name + given name.
people_name_convention.theophoric: names rarely name the powers directly; more often a vision-sign (animal, sky, weather): e.g. a war-vision under Maraksa.

religion._note: Deity-names are morphs of the Agrippan canon in the Plains register (family_north_american.json theonym_sets.plains), never real Plains gods. Shared pantheon, Plains names. Numinan seeds/shifts Neutral or Chaotic; its stance follows its CURRENT alignment (see worship_by_alignment). The powers are met through the vision-quest (puha) and the open sky; the sacred bluff or medicine-cairn is the altar - there are few built temples.
religion.the_one: Ateruna (< Aeternus; the Great-Above - acknowledged as the distant maker when Neutral, reviled as the cold sky-tyrant when Chaotic)

sample_deity_renames.Maraxus: Maraksa (the war-fire, the raider; Chaotic power)

worship_by_alignment.Chaotic: venerate the Chaotic powers (Maraksa the war-fire, Tamawi the storm, Lusanta the greed-serpent), demonize the Lawful powers and the One (Ateruna)
worship_by_alignment.Neutral: all powers ambivalent - somewhat honored, somewhat feared; foreground the ancestral dead, the animal-spirits and the medicine (puha) of place

religion.demon_epithet_pattern: the demonized set (the Lawful powers + the One, when Chaotic) take dread epithets: Tulrius -> Torawi the Cold-Sun; Orlandus -> Olanta the Chain; Aeternus -> Ateruna the Sky-Tyrant.
religion.religious_orders_pattern: few built temples - the medicine-cairn or vision-bluff of [power] on a high place: 'the Medicine-Bluff of Maraksa'.
religion.saints_pattern: the great chiefs and vision-seers who became sky- and animal-spirits; honored at the burial-scaffold and the medicine-cairn.

holy_symbol_motifs.Maraksa: a red war-lance beneath a thunder-cloud
holy_symbol_motifs.Tamawi: the forked storm over the open grass
holy_symbol_motifs.Reawina: a life-giving rain over the green plain

banks_patterns.ships: landlocked riders name war-lances and great horses, not ships: 'Storm-Runner', 'the Red Lance', 'Cloud-Eater' (a famed horse)
banks_patterns.military_units: the warrior-societies: 'the Dog-Soldiers (Hotametaneo)', 'the Kit-Fox society', 'the Elk-Soldiers'
banks_patterns.taverns: camps, not taverns: the council-lodge / the [adjective] tipi: 'the Great Council-Lodge', 'the Red Tipi'
banks_patterns.dungeons_ruins: old burial-scaffolds, abandoned war-camps and spirit-haunted buttes: 'the Medicine-Cairn of [chief]', 'the Ghost-Butte of [name]'
